subject.title: Feature Request: Stream Repetition Safeguard (Halt & Confirm)

question: Should OpenClaw add a core semantic stream-repetition circuit breaker with user confirmation, or keep runaway-generation protection limited to timeouts, sanitizers, and provider/model policy?
rationale: The requested behavior can abort or pause legitimate assistant output and changes session/channel delivery semantics, so maintainers need to choose the default policy and confirmation model before implementation.

options.title: Design a narrow core circuit breaker
options.body: Add an active-path stream guard with conservative thresholds, an explicit user-facing abort or pause message, and regression coverage for legitimate repeated outputs.

options.title: Fold into timeout policy
options.body: Track runaway generation under timeout/fallback work and avoid semantic text inspection until maintainers approve a broader runtime guard.

options.title: Decline core semantic guard
options.body: Leave repetition handling to provider settings, max-token/run timeouts, and output sanitizers, and close this direction after a maintainer decision.

recommendation.title: Design a narrow core circuit breaker
recommendation.body: Add an active-path stream guard with conservative thresholds, an explicit user-facing abort or pause message, and regression coverage for legitimate repeated outputs.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the clearest product-decision owner from related durable reviews and issue routing.
